title: Senior Clay + HubSpot GTM Systems Architect | Enrichment, CRM Governance & Signals
systemName: Your governed enrichment and signals system

facts: Post: design and implement a reusable data, enrichment, and market-intelligence foundation (Clay + HubSpot).
Post: establish source-of-truth, field-precedence, and writeback rules; protect known-good HubSpot data from enrichment overwrites.
Post: enrichment waterfalls, stop-on-success, avoid paying for data already in HubSpot, test before large runs.
Post: trigger signals such as leadership changes, expansion, cybersecurity events, funding, acquisitions.
Post: QA checkpoints before writeback, batch/run tracking, correct erroneous updates without overwriting later legitimate changes.
Company name stated in post: Bumblebee IT Services (BBITS). No contact first name in post; personalization omitted.
No HubSpot or Clay adapter exists; all screens use the custom workbench. HubSpot builds are not a confirmed Lorenzo fact.
